root_cause.text: The `rtw88` driver redundantly increments the reference count of the parent USB device using `usb_get_dev()` during initialization but fails to release it on all probe error paths, leading to a device reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the redundant `usb_get_dev()` call in `rtw_usb_intf_init()` and its corresponding `usb_put_dev()` call in `rtw_usb_intf_deinit()`, which was not reached during early probe failures.

intent_record.intent_summary: Avoid an unnecessary reference count increment on the USB device to prevent a reference leak.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to usb_get_dev() when initializing the udev pointer from the usb_interface.
intent_record.how: This change prevents incrementing the reference count of the USB device structure, which avoids a reference count leak since there is no corresponding put operation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature usb_put_dev call in rtw_usb_intf_deinit to fix USB device reference counting.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to usb_put_dev(rtwusb->udev) from the rtw_usb_intf_deinit function.
intent_record.how: This change prevents decrementing the reference count of the USB device during interface deinitialization, avoiding potential use-after-free or double-free issues if the reference is managed elsewhere.
